tabs.html:
i -POOK PK65H Multi-Purpose Wire Tracker Cable Tester with Underground Cable Locator


The i-POOK PK65H is a professional-grade multi-purpose wire tracker and cable tester designed for accurate tracing, testing, and locating of cables — including underground and hidden wires. Ideal for network installers, electricians, and DIY enthusiasts, this device offers an efficient solution for identifying cable paths and diagnosing connectivity issues.


Equipped with advanced detection technology, the PK65H can trace Ethernet, telephone, coaxial, and electrical cables, even when buried underground or behind walls. The receiver and transmitter system ensures precise signal tracking, while built-in tone generator and continuity test functions make it easy to find cable breaks, shorts, and miswires.


Whether you're maintaining network lines, testing telephone cables, or locating electrical wiring, the i-POOK PK65H simplifies your task with clear LED indicators, adjustable signal strength, and a user-friendly interface.


Key Features:


  • Tests RJ45 (LAN) and RJ11 (telephone) cables
  • Supports UTP and STP cable testing
  • Accurately identifies and traces wires among multiple lines
  • Works in unpowered electrical systems
  • Detects short circuits, open circuits, miswires, and cross connections
  • Auto-scan mode for full LAN cable connectivity check (1-8)
  • Traces PoE-connected Ethernet cables
  • Visible laser beam for optical fiber fault checking
  • Audio and visual signal indicators
  • Earphone output for noisy environments
  • Adjustable volume and LED flashlight for dark areas
  • Auto power-off for extended battery life
